title: Recipient Check
summary: Reduces misaddressed email by flagging external recipients, lookalike or typo'd domains, duplicates and names paired with the wrong address.
description: Recipient field that marks external addresses in amber, catches typo'd and lookalike domains with a one-tap fix, blocks duplicates, spots a known name paired with someone else's address, and warns when a message goes to too many people.
catches: Typo'd consumer domains (gmial.com → gmail.com) with a one-tap fix
A known contact's name paired with a different address
More recipients than warnAt, with a one-tap remove-externals
limits: Typo detection uses edit distance against a built-in list and your domains; unusual domains can be missed or wrongly flagged
Does not check that a mailbox exists
Name/address mismatch only works for people in contacts
a11y: Visible <label> tied to the input; aria-invalid when any recipient has an error
Enter, comma, semicolon or Tab commits an address; Backspace on an empty field arms then removes the last chip
Chip issues are spoken through sr-only text; each remove button has an aria-label
Warnings and fixes render in a polite live region; icons are aria-hidden
stops: Email sent to the wrong address
